Ticket scanning uses Tesseract.js 6.0.1 (naptha/tesseract.js), tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 (naptha/tesseract.js-core), and English fast trained data from tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast (tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast). Apache License 2.0; see accompanying LICENSE files. Distribution assets are unmodified. Ticket photos and extracted text are processed locally and are not uploaded.
